meta_description: Welcome to 30A Serenity Sands & The Coastal Clubhouse on 30A by AvantStay! These two homes are right next door to each other, with a combined total of 14 bedrooms, sleeping 39 guests---an ideal option for family trips or groups looking to spread out.
description_expanded:
Welcome to 30A Serenity Sands \& The Coastal Clubhouse on 30A by AvantStay! These two homes are right next door to each other, with a combined total of 14 bedrooms, sleeping 39 guests---an ideal option for family trips or groups looking to spread out.

ABOUT THE HOMES: Welcome to the exquisite 30A Serenity Sands \& The Coastal Clubhouse on 30A, two awe-inspiring newly constructed luxury homes situated in the vibrant heart of Gulf Place. Whether you're seeking a haven for family reunions or a haven for corporate retreats, these two remarkable residences promise an unparalleled fusion of opulence and comfort. Nestled just a stone's throw away from Gulf Place/Dune Allen, renowned as one of 30a's destinations, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of convenience, with shopping, dining, nightly entertainment, and an array of activities at your fingertips. The homes have an abundance of spaces designed for both entertaining and relaxation. From the expansive kitchen islands that graciously accommodate up to 14 guests to the irresistible allure of the heated pools and spas, every facet of these homes is meticulously crafted to elevate your beach getaway experience. Step outside onto the multiple levels, balconies, and outdoor patio spaces, where the gentle sea breeze invites you to unwind amidst the serene surroundings. Whether you're basking in the camaraderie of group gatherings or seeking moments of solitude, 30A Serenity Sands \& The Coastal Clubhouse on 30A offer a plethora of options to suit your every mood. Enjoy complimentary golf carts at each home.

ABOUT THE AREA: Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow folks down with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, plentiful green spaces, and park benches to sit and enjoy the views. This community features some of 30A's most popular restaurants, like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Whether you are looking for an epic culinary experience, a fun feast for the whole family or just grab a quick bite to take to the beach, Gulf Place has it all.

BEACH ACCESS: This lovely home is 3 blocks from Ed Walline Public Beach Access. Hop on your bikes and take a stroll down to the beach!

ACCOMMODATIONS AT EACH HOME:
• Primary Bedroom -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 3 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 5 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 6 -- 2 Sets of Triple XL Twin Bunks, shared ensuite bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 7 -- 1 Set of Triple XL Twin Bunk -- 3rd Floor
• Sleeper sofa (\*Only at Serenity Sands)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Golf cart included!
• Private heated pool \& spa
• Private backyard
• 3 blocks to the beach
• New construction
• 4 Adult Bikes
• Peekaboo views of the Gulf
• Game room on 3rd floor
• Outdoor entertainment area with grill
• Smart TV's throughout the house
• Full Size Washer \& Dryers on each floor
• Fully stocked chef's kitchen with enormous island, 2 dishwashers, coffee maker (Drip \& Pod)

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note: 30A Serenity Sands features a queen sleeper sofa located on the third floor that is not pictured in the current photos.
- Pool heat at 30A Serenity Sands is $150 per day and must be added for the entire length of stay. No exceptions. Tampering with pool equipment will result in a $200 charge.

Parking Details:
- Each home has room to park 4 vehicles.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
